states.name: S0
states.meaning: Reset/no-prefix state. No nonempty suffix of the input is a prefix of 1101. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to S1 and data=0 stays S0. Synchronous reset forces S0.

states.name: S1
states.meaning: Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '1'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to S11 and data=0 goes to S0.

states.name: S11
states.meaning: Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '11'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=0 goes to S110 and data=1 stays S11 because '111' has suffix '11'.

states.name: S110
states.meaning: Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '110'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to FOUND and data=0 goes to S0.

states.name: FOUND
states.meaning: Sequence 1101 has been detected; start_shifting is held at 1. With reset==0 at a posedge, any data stays FOUND. Synchronous reset forces S0.

rules.condition: reset == 0 and (state == FOUND or (state == S110 and data == 1))
rules.spec_quote: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.

rules.condition: reset == 0 and state != FOUND and not (state == S110 and data == 1)

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first posedge with reset==0 after a sampled reset-high posedge; state S0 is active and normal 1101 detection may proceed from that release edge.

mid: Optional mid object may contain reset and/or data changes after the row's posedge sample; changed values are carried to the next row's pre-edge inputs.

uncertain.note: The specification says start_shifting is set when 1101 is found but does not explicitly distinguish same-edge assertion after the final data bit from next-edge assertion; this contract selects same_cycle after the sampled posedge that completes 1101.
candidates: start_shifting becomes 1 on the first sampled posedge that latches data=1 completing 1101
start_shifting becomes 1 on the next sampled posedge after data=1 completes 1101

uncertain.note: The specification only states that reset is active high synchronous and does not explicitly specify the value of start_shifting while reset is asserted; this contract assumes it clears to 0.
candidates: start_shifting is 0 while reset is asserted and on the release edge
start_shifting retains its previous value while reset is asserted

uncertain.note: The specification only says start_shifting is set to 1 when 1101 is found and does not explicitly specify its value before detection; this contract assumes it is 0.
candidates: start_shifting is undefined or retains its previous value before 1101 is detected

r_set_or_hold: start_shifting becomes 1 on the first sampled posedge that latches data=1 completing 1101
start_shifting becomes 1 on the next sampled posedge after data=1 completes 1101
Assert start_shifting on the next sampled posedge after the completing data bit.
r_reset_clear: start_shifting is 0 while reset is asserted and on the release edge
start_shifting retains its previous value while reset is asserted
r_default_clear: start_shifting is undefined or retains its previous value before 1101 is detected
